dedupe_keys.name: bd tempetes impact des tempetes hivernales depuis l hiver 2019 2020

description: BD Tempetes - Impact des tempetes hivernales depuis l'hiver 2019 2020 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Results of the work of the BD Tempetes of the Observatoire de la Côte Aquitaine. Estimated decline by municipality. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "BD Tempetes - Impact of winter tempetes since winter 2019 2020" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include 2020, 2019, aquitaine, tempetes, erosion, littoral_oca. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
